title: AirSIM Cardputer
summary: Calls, SMS and two-way audio through an Android phone over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
description: Independent AirSIM client for Cardputer Zero. Connect to an Android phone running AirSIM using Wi-Fi discovery/manual pairing or VoBLE Bluetooth, or to a compatible MU-300 running the AirSIM MU-300 plugin over Wi-Fi. Make and answer calls, send and receive SMS, use two-way call audio, and view device battery, unread messages and missed-call numbers. Includes local contacts, call records, SIM selection and DTMF. Version 0.3.13 adds PipeWire/WebRTC echo cancellation, bounded playback and microphone gain, and authenticated receive-only carrier early audio for MU-300 Wi-Fi outgoing calls. Runs as the ordinary pi user. The app must remain open for incoming calls. No cloud/Relay mode. Wi-Fi pairing uses the Android local-mode protocol and asks before replacing its cloud registration. SMS uses the existing shared delivery queue: other clients acknowledging messages first can remove them before this client reads them. For reliable Wi-Fi reception, avoid simultaneous local SMS synchronization by other clients. Store screenshots and the older UI recording use synthetic data; the separately attached physical-device video was supplied and approved for publication by the user. An Android phone with AirSIM and its required permissions is needed. This is not an official AirSIM release.
